messages:
Alex Kim: opened a small PR to add a CLI sample app for the ruby sample repo — it's basically the minimal interactive example contributors asked for. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/123|#123>. CI is failing on windows and ruby-head though, can someone advise?
Maria Chen: saw the failure from the bot, thanks @Alex. Can you paste the failing log? I'm fine with a small CI tweak but want to understand root cause first.
CI Bot: GitHub Actions job 'matrix (windows-latest, ruby-head)' failed: `LoadError: cannot load such file -- win32console` at lib/tty/input.rb:34. Full log: <link omitted>.
Alex Kim: log snippet: ```
Fetching gem metadata...
Installing win32console 1.0.5 (was optional)
LoadError: cannot load such file -- win32console
  from /usr/share/ruby/tty/input.rb:34:in `require'
```
I purposely kept the sample tiny so not adding heavy deps — looks like some transitive require pulls in win32console on Windows runs. My quick fix was adding the gem with platforms to the Gemfile: ```ruby
gem 'win32console', platforms: [:mswin, :mingw, :x64_mingw]
```
but that feels meh for a sample app.
Jon Patel: is this sample intended to be used in partner onboarding? If yes, I'd prefer the CI keep Windows so we don't ship a sample that's broken on Windows. If it's just a tiny demo, we can drop windows from the matrix to reduce friction.
Emma García: also see that ruby-head (3.x-dev) tends to be noisy. Python sampleapp doesn't run legacy-dev in CI. Suggest matrix: [2.7, 3.0, 3.1] only. And Alex, for the Gemfile you can guard windows requirements with a conditional in the CI rather than the sample's Gemfile itself.
Alex Kim: updated the PR: removed ruby-head from the matrix and added an install step in the windows job that only installs win32console when on windows. Diff: ```yaml
matrix:
  os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
  ruby: [2.7, 3.0, 3.1]
steps:
  - name: install windows gems
    if: runner.os == 'Windows'
    run: gem install win32console || true
```
Also added a tiny README note about Windows quirks. @Maria can we backport the CI tweak to v0.8.x? Partner depends on that branch.
Maria Chen: backporting CI-only changes is okay, but removing ruby-head from the matrix is a behavioral change. For main branch LGTM, but for a patch branch please split into two PRs: (1) ci: matrix pin for v0.8.x, (2) main sample + README on main. We also need a CHANGES entry for backport.
Ryan O'Neill: quick security note — avoid adding new gems to the sample in a patch release without a security review. CI tweak is fine, adding optional gems maybe not.
Alex Kim: good call, I'll split the PRs. I'll keep the sample Gemfile clean and put the windows helper only in CI. Thanks everyone.
DevEx Bot: assigned @Maria Chen as reviewer and added reaction :white_check_mark:.
Maria Chen: small nit: please use `bundle exec ruby` in the README examples to reduce confusion for Windows folks who run into PATH/binstubs. otherwise LGTM, will review the CI-only PR once split.
